k:HH.Underworld.Page.Whispers.Desc: Every bout, deal and gang visit adds whispers, and they fade over time. More whispers bring more outlaws and fewer respectable guests.

k:HH.Underworld.Pit.CallOpponent.Desc: Hire a pit beast for a lone fighter: an animal about as strong as your fighter, for one bout. The colony pays {0} silver: from the till first, then silver in stock, then the bank.
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.CallOpponent.FreeDes: The first opponent is on the house.
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.FightersBtn.Desc: Everyone who could fight in this pit and why someone cannot fight now. Tick the colonists who may fight here, pick two sides and start a bout, or call an opponent for a lone fighter.
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.Guests.Desc: Guests may fight here: shady guests and gang members always, other adult guests when they are not kind and have bloodlust, the brawler trait or melee 6 and more. Only guests who are awake, idle, healthy and staying a while. Their bouts are fought for points: nobody gets hurt, and a winning guest gets a small purse from the house take.
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.Hint.Wait: wait for a guest who likes to fight
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.Lethal.Desc: Bouts between prisoners and animals only end when one of them is down. Never for guests, colonists or slaves: their bouts are always fought for points.
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.Prisoners.Desc: Prisoners of the colony aged 18 or older may fight here. The guards bring them into the arena and back to their cell.
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.Result.Draw: {0} against {1}: no winner. All stakes are returned.
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.Result.Points: It was fought for points: {0} has a few bruises at most.
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.Result.PointsAll: It was fought for points: a few bruises at most.
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.Result.Won: {0} beat {1} in the pit. Pool {2} silver, house {3} silver.
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.StartNow.Desc: Start a bout now: the sides picked under Fighters, or the two closest fighters. No guests needed, and the fairness limit does not apply.
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.Status.AutoFailed: No automatic bout: {0}. Start a bout yourself or call an opponent.
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.Status.Closed: Closed: switch on "Pit open" on the marker.
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.Status.NoFighter: No fighters yet: right-click the marker with a colonist, or tick one under Fighters.
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.Status.Off: The underworld is switched off (module or Cozy content).
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.Status.Peaceful: Peaceful underworld is on: no fights.
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.Status.WaitGuests: Waiting for guests to bet (you can start a bout yourself).
k:HH.Underworld.Pit.Volunteers.Desc: From an older save: colonists with bloodlust or melee 8 and more also fight without being ticked under Fighters. Switch it off to let only the ticked colonists fight. Colonists never fight to the death.
